name: Fuyutsuki Haruta
source: The main character of the story. He has always had a crush on his childhood friend Rio. Due to his timid personality, he was unable to say anything, but Kaito, who is like a big brother to him, pushed him and he was finally able to tell her how he felt. The happy future he believed in with Rio was cruelly trampled on...
